Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class Listing

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.Listing
Direct Known Subclasses:
GiveawayListing, LendListing, SaleListing
public abstract class Listing extends Object
An item a seller posts (Listing in the domain class diagram). Every listing is exactly one of SaleListing, LendListing or GiveawayListing ({complete, disjoint}), so the type cannot change after posting.

Status. The status changes only through the event methods in the state machine section below (approve, reject, resubmit, acceptDeal, completeDeal, withdraw, remove). Each one refuses a change the state machine does not allow, so an impossible status, such as a sale listing that is "Lent", cannot happen. The diagram and the use case behind each event are in docs/state-machines.md. The seller is stored by username, so listings can later be saved to files without object cycles. The username is kept in lower case without surrounding spaces, as accounts keep it, whatever way it was typed (for example by the admin in Add Listing).

    • isLocked

      public boolean isLocked()

    • approve

      public void approve()
      The admin approves the listing, so it goes Live (Manage Marketplace Listings 5.2). A listing the admin adds is approved right after it is created (5.6.4).

    • reject

      public void reject()
      The admin rejects the listing; the reason is kept in a ListingActionRecord (5.3).

    • resubmit

      public void resubmit()
      The seller saved changes, so the listing waits for review again (Manage Listings 3.1.6).

    • withdraw

      public void withdraw()
      The seller deleted the listing. It stays stored with status Removed (Manage Listings 3.2.4).

    • remove

      public void remove()
      The admin removed the listing (Manage Marketplace Listings 5.5.4). This is allowed until the listing is Sold, Given or already Removed. A deal accepted before the removal can still be completed, and the listing then stays Removed (UC12 A1; assumption for Reserved listings).

    • canBeRemoved

      public boolean canBeRemoved()
      True unless the listing is Sold, Given or already Removed: those stay as they are, as records.

    • acceptDeal

      public void acceptDeal()
      The seller accepted an offer, borrow request or claim: the listing becomes Reserved for a sale or giveaway, or Lent for a lend listing (UC7 Special Requirement 5).

    • completeDeal

      public void completeDeal()
      The accepted deal was completed: a sale becomes Sold, a giveaway Given, and a returned lend listing Live again (UC7 steps 6 and A2, UC12 step 3). If the admin removed the listing in the meantime, it stays Removed (UC7 A2, UC12 A1).
